[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-r0[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]tmux Agent — launch an interactive agent CLI in a new tmux window[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Pressing `t` in Launch Control, or running `sase tmux-agent`, opens[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a keyboard-first chooser of every registered agent-CLI provider and[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]drops the chosen one into a fresh, auto-numbered tmux window in the[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]current directory. Both surfaces share one registry-driven catalog,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]so a newly registered provider plugin appears with no code change [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]here.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
